local function getDescription(characterName, frame, descriptionType)
    local description
    if descriptionType == "story" then
        description = p.story_desc[characterName]
    elseif descriptionType == "mansion" then
    	description = p.mansion_desc[characterName]
    else
        description = p.descriptions[characterName]
    end

    if description then
        return frame:preprocess(description)
    else
        return nil
    end
end

function p.getDescription(frame, characterName)
    return getDescription(characterName, frame)
end

function p.getStoryDesc(frame, characterName)
    return getDescription(characterName, frame, "story")
end

function p.getMansionDesc(frame, characterName)
    return getDescription(characterName, frame, "mansion")
end

-- Function to get custom DPS data based on character *name* (from InfoChar/Data)
function p.getCustomDPS(characterName)
    return p.customDPS[characterName]
end

return p
